name: Cheng Fwa Industrial Co., Ltd.
summary: Cheng Fwa Industrial Co., Ltd., established in 1964 and headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan, is a leading manufacturer and supplier specializing in high-precision metal stamped components. The company produces parts in various configurations and dimensions for critical applications across the computer, telecommunication, networking, and wider electronics sectors. Their extensive product line encompasses precisely stamped items such as web camera shields, tuner chassis, and air compressor components. They also furnish a broad spectrum of electronic parts, including printer components, PDA and PDA LCD frames, various springs, and notebook parts. Furthermore, Cheng Fwa fabricates diverse chassis and enclosures for communication boxes, numerous PC models (including IBM PC chassis, MVC-006X, hubs, and general PC cases), webcams, set-top boxes, kiosks, and satellite dish antennas. Beyond their core metal stamping expertise, the company manufactures a range of plastic injection molded parts, such as T-handles, power button components, front panels, HDD frames, light pipes, Point of Sale (POS) rear covers, satellite receivers, and cable modems. Their industrial product offerings also extend to die-cast components, LED parts, and automotive components. Cheng Fwa provides comprehensive, full-lifecycle services, encompassing product design, rapid prototype fabrication and low-volume production, tooling design and manufacturing, and large-scale mass production. The company further supports clients through flexible engagement models, including Original Equipment Manufacturing (OEM), Original Design Manufacturing (ODM), collaborative design and development, processing, assembly, testing, and packaging services.
